businesses.business: Payroll, HR and spend management software

offering_description.value: Paylocity sells cloud software for payroll, HR, workforce management and business spending to employers, primarily small and midsize organizations. It also handles payroll tax filing and remittance and coordinates international payroll through local providers.

primary_products.value: payroll software; HR and benefits software; time and attendance software; talent management software; accounts payable, expense and corporate card software

primary_services.value: payroll tax filing and remittance; managed international payroll; software implementation and data migration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small and midsize employers, larger employers, and nonprofit organizations

end_markets.value: professional services; healthcare; retail and hospitality; manufacturing; nonprofits

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to payroll, HR, workforce and spend management software, often priced by employee count and modules; service fees: Initial setup and implementation for new customers; interest or premiums: Interest on client funds held before wages and payroll taxes are remitted
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops and hosts software that employers use to manage employee records, payroll and business spending; service provider: Uses employer payroll data and funds to process payments, file taxes and coordinate international payroll

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with international payroll coverage across Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America through local providers

specialization.value: related lines: Payroll, HR, workforce and talent management, and accounts payable and expense management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: In-house sales teams sell to HR, payroll and finance leaders; partners / resellers: Referral relationships with benefits brokers, accountants and other business advisers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Payroll tax filing and remittance follow IRS and state tax rules, and employee data is subject to privacy requirements.

notes: The pricing structure for spend management and corporate card services is uncertain.
